g.text: Individual and binned working Pearson residuals
Primary-model diagnostics aggregate concurrent activity memberships back to one contribution per original participant-hour.
Participant-cluster covariance changes inferential uncertainty; it does not remove serial correlation or zero-mass mismatch.
